text:
Maya Singh: quick follow-up from the postmortem 1: noticed two incidents used large initial rollouts + no forced rollback. want concrete follow-ups.
Diego Morales: agree. propose small, fast-to-deploy changes: default initial_pct=3%, ramp=20m, auto-abort on short-error spike.
Priya Nair: add escalation: auto-abort should create an "auto-abort" incident and page oncall if abort happens. add tag on flags that aborted.
Lina Chen: I'll build per-flag concurrent user caps in the flagging service. default conservative caps for prod, adjustable in admin.
Diego Morales: I'll own auto-abort infra: schema, enforcement, and a synthetic replay test harness using sanitized traffic. ETA: Tue 2026-03-31.
Maya Singh: I'll update the postmortem action tracker and run a quick 15min sync after PRs land.
Priya Nair: I'll update the runbook and add the abort incident template. also want a quarterly audit ticket for flags with >1 abort in 90d.
ops-bot: ticket created INF-4802 -> quarterly flag audit assigned to product-ops.
Lina Chen: ETA for middleware + metrics + dashboard tile: Thu 2026-04-02. happy to pair on tests Thu AM.
Maya Singh: action items: 1) Diego - auto-abort schema + PR + replay tests (due 2026-03-31) 2) Lina - flag cap middleware + metrics (due 2026-04-02) 3) Priya - runbook + audit ticket (due 2026-04-03) 4) Maya - tracker + sync (due 2026-03-30).
Diego Morales: starting branch now, will link PR when ready.
Priya Nair: thanks all. we'll use this thread for quick updates. :thumbsup:
